chunks: Ḥammād ibn ʿĪsā narrated from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:

While the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله was in one of his rooms, a man looked through a crack in the door. The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله had a combing stick in his hand and said: "If I were close to you, I would have gouged out your eye with it."

key_terms.شِقِّ الْبَابِ: a crack or opening in the door through which someone looks
key_terms.لَفَقَأْتُ: I would have put out or gouged out
key_terms.مِذْرَاةٌ: a combing stick or small grooming implement held in the hand

ai.seo_question: What does this hadith say about peeking into someone's home and violating privacy?
ai.summary: This hadith describes the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله condemning the act of secretly looking into another person's private space. It indicates the seriousness of violating privacy and appears in a legal context concerning injury without blood money liability.
